verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes documents developer building blocks only: a code interpreter with rich outputs (charts, tables) and positioning as a base for building data analysis platforms. There is no evidence that the product itself generates AI insights or suggestions from a user's data. Constructing such a feature on top of the SDK is a developer building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
